parallel.def_en: always the same distance apart, like two lines that never meet; very similar to something else

root.logic: para(在旁边)+allelos(彼此)→彼此并排延伸→平行的；并行的
root.note: 希腊语 parallēlos，经拉丁语和法语进入英语。

ex2.en: The new railway runs almost parallel to the old coastal road for some thirty kilometres.
ex2.zh: 这条新铁路有大约三十公里几乎与旧的滨海公路平行。
ex2.note: parallel to 是固定搭配，不用 with；此类描述常出现在听力地图题与城市交通类写作中。

parallel.use: 听力（地图题）· 写作（城市/交通）

peninsula.def_en: a piece of land that is almost surrounded by water but is still joined to the mainland

root.logic: paene(几乎)+insula(岛)→几乎是一座岛→半岛
root.note: paene 在构词中缩为 pen-。

ex2.en: The peninsula is famous for its mild winters, which attract retired people from the north.
ex2.zh: 这个半岛以温和的冬季闻名，吸引了来自北方的退休人士。
ex2.note: 这里 peninsula 指三面临水、一面连陆的地形，与 island 相对，是地理类阅读与地图题的高频词。

peninsula.use: 阅读（地理）· 听力（地图题）

rough.def_en: not smooth or even to touch; not exact or detailed

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族单音节词，不宜再拆

ex2.en: The track is too rough for small cars, so visitors usually walk the last two kilometres.
ex2.zh: 这条小路太崎岖，小汽车开不了，所以游客通常步行最后两公里。
ex2.note: rough 兼指'表面粗糙'与'粗略的'，a rough estimate 是写作常用搭配；此处取'崎岖'义。

rough.use: 听力（路线描述）· 阅读（地理）

sandy.def_en: covered with sand, or containing a large amount of sand

root.logic: sand(沙)+-y(充满…的)→多沙的，铺满沙的

ex2.en: Sandy soils drain quickly, so farmers in this coastal district must irrigate their fields more often than inland growers.
ex2.zh: 沙质土壤排水很快，因此这一沿海地区的农民必须比内陆种植者更频繁地灌溉田地。
ex2.note: sandy soil 是农业与地理类阅读的高频搭配；-y 后缀表'充满某物'，同理 stony、muddy。

sandy.use: 阅读（农业/地理）· 写作（环境）

shallow.def_en: not deep; or not showing serious and careful thought about anything

root.logic: 联想：与 shoal(浅滩) 形近，借'浅滩'记住'浅'
root.note: 词源存疑：以下为助记联想，非严格词源（或与古英语 sceald 有关）。

ex2.en: The lake is shallow near the shore, which makes it safe for young children to swim.
ex2.zh: 湖靠近岸边的水域很浅，这让小孩子游泳比较安全。
ex2.note: shallow water 指浅水区；shallow 也可指人'浅薄'，是阅读中评价性词汇，属地理与评论类通用词。

shallow.use: 听力（地理描述）· 写作（评论）

smooth.def_en: having an even surface with no roughness; happening without problems or delays

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，不宜拆分

ex2.en: The government hopes the transition to clean energy will be smooth rather than abrupt, so that households can plan ahead.
ex2.zh: 政府希望向清洁能源的过渡是平稳的而非突然的，以便家庭能够提前规划。
ex2.note: a smooth transition 是评价政策或流程时的高分搭配，含'无波折'之义；反义 abrupt 常与之对照。

smooth.use: 写作（政策/流程）· 听力（材质描述）

steep.def_en: rising or falling sharply; (of an increase or price) very large and sudden

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，不宜拆分

ex2.en: Because the slope is steep, heavy rain quickly runs off and carries the topsoil away.
ex2.zh: 由于坡面陡峭，暴雨很快流走，并把表土冲走。
ex2.note: steep slope 指陡坡；a steep rise in prices 表物价急剧上涨，图表作文中可替换 sharp。

steep.use: 写作 Task 1（数据变化）· 阅读（地形）

stony.def_en: covered with stones, or showing no feeling or sympathy at all

root.logic: stone(石头)+-y(多…的)→多石的
root.note: 拼写上省略 stone 的词尾 e。

ex2.en: Only a few hardy shrubs can survive on the stony ground above the tree line.
ex2.zh: 在林木线以上多石的地面上，只有少数耐寒灌木能够存活。
ex2.note: stony ground 指多石贫瘠的地面；a stony silence 则表'冷冰冰的沉默'，一词两义需看搭配。

stony.use: 阅读（地理/生态）· 听力 Section 4

superficial.def_en: affecting only the surface; not studying or thinking about something deeply

root.logic: super(在上)+ficies(面)+-al→只停留在表面上的→表面的；肤浅的
root.note: 拉丁语 superficialis 由 super- 与 facies(面) 构成。

ex2.en: Most media coverage of the issue has been superficial, focusing on images rather than causes.
ex2.zh: 媒体对该问题的大多数报道都很肤浅，关注的是画面而非原因。
ex2.note: superficial 含贬义，指'只看表面、不深入'；superficial damage 则指'表面损伤'，用于写作评论类文章很合适。

superficial.use: 写作（媒体/教育）· 阅读（评论类）

vertical.def_en: pointing straight up or down, forming an angle of 90 degrees with the ground

root.base: vertic(顶点，拉丁语 vertex，源自 vertere 转)
root.logic: vertic(顶点)+-al→沿顶点方向上下延伸→垂直的
root.note: 同源词 vertex 指'最高点'，与'转'义相关。

ex2.en: The cliff is almost vertical, so climbers need special equipment and a guide to reach the top safely.
ex2.zh: 这处悬崖几乎是垂直的，因此攀登者需要专门装备和向导才能安全到达顶部。
ex2.note: vertical 与 horizontal 相对，vertical cliff/axis 是地理描述与图表题常用词。

vertical.use: 听力（地图/图表）· 阅读（地理）

weather.def_en: the condition of the air at a particular time, including temperature, rain and wind

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，不宜拆分

ex2.en: Farmers in this region check the weather forecast every morning before spraying their crops, especially during the rainy season.
ex2.zh: 该地区的农民每天早晨喷洒作物前都会查看天气预报，雨季尤其如此。
ex2.note: weather 指短期天气状况，climate 指长期气候，二者在写作中不可混用；weather forecast 为高频搭配。

weather.use: 听力 Section 1/2 · 写作（环境）

arid.def_en: very dry, with very little rain, so that few plants can grow

root.base: ar(干，拉丁语 arere 干燥)
root.logic: ar(干)+-id→干燥的

ex2.en: In arid regions, farmers rely on groundwater because annual rainfall rarely exceeds two hundred millimetres and rivers often dry up.
ex2.zh: 在干旱地区，农民依靠地下水，因为年降雨量很少超过两百毫米，河流也常常干涸。
ex2.note: arid climate/region 比 dry 更正式，是环境与农业类阅读的术语，也常用于描述荒漠化。

arid.use: 阅读（环境/农业）· 写作（气候）

damp.def_en: slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way that makes a place feel cold

root.base: damp(中古低地德语 damp，雾气、蒸汽)
root.logic: damp(雾气)+→被水汽笼罩→阴湿的
root.note: 借自低地德语，原指雾气，后指物体带潮气。

ex2.en: Damp housing is linked to asthma, especially among children who live in older buildings with poor ventilation and heating.
ex2.zh: 潮湿的住房与哮喘有关，住在通风和供暖都不佳的老旧建筑里的儿童尤为明显。
ex2.note: damp 指'阴湿'，带负面色彩，与 moist 的中性不同；damp housing 是英国社会议题高频搭配。

damp.use: 写作（住房/健康）· 阅读（社会类）

frost.def_en: a thin white layer of ice that forms on surfaces when the temperature falls below freezing

root.base: frost(古英语 frost，与 freeze 同源)
root.logic: 整体记忆：与 freeze 同源，可一并记忆

ex2.en: Late frost in April can destroy the apple blossom and ruin the whole year's harvest.
ex2.zh: 四月的晚霜会冻坏苹果花，毁掉一整年的收成。
ex2.note: frost 指地面或物体表面的白霜；late frost、frost damage 是农业类阅读常见表达。

frost.use: 阅读（农业）· 听力（天气）

heating.def_en: the system or process of making a building or room warm

root.logic: heat(热)+-ing→加热的过程或设备→供暖

ex2.en: Installing better insulation and double glazing cut the school's heating bills by nearly a third last winter.
ex2.zh: 去年冬天，安装更好的隔热层和双层玻璃使学校的供暖费用降低了近三分之一。
ex2.note: heating bill/system 指供暖费用与系统；heating 作'供暖'解时不可数，不加 a。

heating.use: 听力 Section 2（住宿）· 写作（能源）

humid.def_en: having a lot of water in the air, so that the air feels wet and sticky

root.base: hum(湿，拉丁语 humere 潮湿)
root.logic: hum(湿)+-id→潮湿的
root.note: 同源词 humidity(湿度)、humour(原指体液)。

ex2.en: Summers here are hot and humid, which makes outdoor work exhausting for construction staff and farmers alike.
ex2.zh: 这里的夏天又热又潮，这让户外工作对建筑工人和农民来说同样消耗体力。
ex2.note: humid 专指空气湿度大，常与 hot 连用；名词 humidity 用于描述气候数据。

humid.use: 听力 Section 4（气候）· 写作（环境）

meteorology.def_en: the scientific study of the atmosphere and of weather conditions

root.logic: meteoro(高空现象)+log(学问)+-y→研究高空大气现象的学科→气象学
root.note: meteor 现指'流星'，但在该词中泛指高空现象。

ex2.en: Advances in meteorology now allow typhoons to be predicted several days before they reach land.
ex2.zh: 气象学的进步使台风能在登陆前几天就被预测出来。
ex2.note: meteorology 为不可数名词，meteorologist 指气象学家；属 Section 4 讲座类学术词。

meteorology.use: 阅读（科学类）· 听力 Section 4

mild.def_en: not severe or extreme; (of weather) warmer than usual for the season

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，不宜拆分

ex2.en: The mild climate of the island allows crops to be grown all year round, which supports a stable local economy.
ex2.zh: 这座岛温和的气候使作物可以全年种植，这支撑了当地稳定的经济。
ex2.note: mild 修饰气候表'温和'，修饰疾病表'轻微的'；a mild winter 是气候类高频搭配。

mild.use: 阅读（气候）· 听力（天气播报）

moderate.def_en: neither very large nor very small; average in amount or degree

root.logic: mod(尺度)+-erate→合乎尺度的→适度的；(使)合乎尺度→缓和

ex2.en: Moderate exercise three times a week significantly reduces the risk of heart disease in middle-aged adults.
ex2.zh: 每周三次适度运动能显著降低中年成年人患心脏病的风险。
ex2.note: 形容词读 /ˈmɑːdərət/，动词'缓和'读 /ˈmɑːdəreɪt/；moderate 常修饰 exercise、growth、view。

moderate.use: 写作（健康/数据）· 阅读（社会类）

moist.def_en: slightly wet, especially in a way that is pleasant or good for plants

root.logic: 联想：moist 与 moisture(水分) 同形记忆→带水分而未滴落→微湿的
root.note: 词源存疑：以下为助记联想，非严格词源（古法语 moiste 的来源有争议）。

ex2.en: Seeds germinate fastest in warm, moist soil, so the nursery keeps the beds covered with cloth overnight.
ex2.zh: 种子在温暖湿润的土壤中发芽最快，因此苗圃整夜用布盖着苗床。
ex2.note: moist 是中性偏褒的'湿润'，与 damp 的负面色彩不同；moist soil 为植物学常用搭配，出现在生态类阅读中。

moist.use: 阅读（植物/生态）· 听力 Section 4

snowy.def_en: covered with snow, or with a great deal of snow falling

root.logic: snow(雪)+-y(多…的)→多雪的，被雪覆盖的

ex2.en: Snowy winters are becoming rarer in the south of the country as the climate warms.
ex2.zh: 随着气候变暖，该国南部多雪的冬天正变得越来越少见。
ex2.note: snowy 由 snow+-y 构成，表'多雪的'；snowy peak 常用于风景描述与旅游话题。

snowy.use: 听力（天气/旅游）· 阅读（气候）

thermal.def_en: relating to heat or to temperature, especially in a scientific or industrial context

root.logic: therm(热)+-al→热的，热量的

ex2.en: Geothermal plants use thermal energy from deep underground to generate electricity without burning any fossil fuel.
ex2.zh: 地热发电厂利用地下深处的热能发电，无需燃烧任何化石燃料。
ex2.note: thermal energy/power 是能源类阅读核心术语；thermal 也可指'保暖的'，如 thermal clothing。

thermal.use: 阅读（能源/科技）· 听力 Section 4

tropics.def_en: the hottest part of the world, between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn

root.logic: trop(回转)+-ics→太阳到此折返的回归线→南北回归线之间的地带→热带
root.note: tropic 原指'回归线'，因太阳到达该线后折返而得名。

ex2.en: Deforestation in the tropics releases huge amounts of carbon and threatens species that live nowhere else on Earth.
ex2.zh: 热带地区的森林砍伐释放出大量碳，并威胁着地球上其他地方没有的物种。
ex2.note: the tropics 必须带定冠词；in the tropics 是环境类写作固定表达。

tropics.use: 写作（环境）· 阅读（生态）

warm.def_en: fairly hot in a pleasant way; friendly; to make something slightly hotter

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，不宜拆分

ex2.en: Warm ocean currents keep the ports on this coast ice-free throughout the winter, which helps trade enormously.
ex2.zh: 温暖的洋流使这一海岸的港口整个冬天都不结冰，这对贸易帮助极大。
ex2.note: warm current 指暖流，与 cold current 相对；warm 亦可作动词表'使变暖'。

warm.use: 阅读（海洋/气候）· 写作（环境）

chill.def_en: to make something cold; a feeling of coldness in the air or body

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，不宜拆分

ex2.en: A sudden chill in the evening forced the campers to put on their extra layers.
ex2.zh: 傍晚骤然袭来的寒意迫使露营者加穿了衣服。
ex2.note: chill 可作名词'寒意'、动词'使冷却'；catch a chill 表'着凉'，口语中还可用 chill 表'放松'。

chill.use: 听力（天气/户外）· 阅读（气候）

downpour.def_en: a heavy fall of rain that continues for a short time

root.logic: down(向下)+pour(倾倒)→从天倾倒而下→倾盆大雨

ex2.en: A sudden downpour flooded the underpass and delayed traffic for more than two hours during the morning rush.
ex2.zh: 早高峰时一场突如其来的倾盆大雨淹没了地下通道，使交通延误了两个多小时。
ex2.note: downpour 为可数名词，a heavy downpour 是听力天气场景与灾害描述的高频表达。

downpour.use: 听力 Section 2（天气）· 阅读（灾害）

freeze.def_en: to become hard and solid because of extreme cold; to keep something at a very low temperature

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，不宜拆分
root.note: 过去式 froze，过去分词 frozen。

ex2.en: The pond freezes over every January, and children are warned to stay off the ice.
ex2.zh: 这个池塘每年一月都会结冰，孩子们被警告不要上冰。
ex2.note: freeze over 指水面'全面结冰'；freeze 也可用于经济语境，表'冻结（资金、价格）'。

freeze.use: 听力（天气）· 阅读（气候/经济）

frigid.def_en: extremely cold, especially of air or water; unfriendly in manner

root.base: frig(冷，拉丁语 frigere 寒冷)
root.logic: frig(冷)+-id→寒冷的
root.note: 同源词 refrigerator(冰箱)。

ex2.en: Few species can survive in the frigid waters that surround the Antarctic continent for most of the year.
ex2.zh: 几乎没有物种能在一年中大部分时间环绕南极大陆的极寒水域里生存。
ex2.note: frigid 比 cold 程度更强，多用于书面语；frigid water/zone 常见于极地地理阅读。

frigid.use: 阅读（极地/生态）· 听力 Section 4

hail.def_en: frozen rain that falls as small balls of ice; to praise someone publicly

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，名词'冰雹'与动词'称赞'同形异源感，靠语境区分

ex2.en: The storm brought hail the size of golf balls, which damaged car roofs across the city.
ex2.zh: 这场风暴带来了高尔夫球大小的冰雹，损坏了全城的汽车车顶。
ex2.note: hail 作名词指冰雹，作动词表'称赞'或'招呼'；hail a taxi 是'叫出租车'，属听力场景常用语。

hail.use: 听力（天气）· 阅读（灾害）

lightning.def_en: a bright flash of electricity produced in the sky during a storm

root.logic: lighten(闪亮)+-ing→天空闪亮→闪电
root.note: 原写作 lightening，后缩为 lightning，以区别'变亮'之义。

ex2.en: Lightning struck the old oak tree and started a fire that spread across the hillside.
ex2.zh: 闪电击中了那棵老橡树，引发的大火烧遍了整个山坡。
ex2.note: lightning 是名词'闪电'，lightening 才是'变亮'；at lightning speed 表'极快地'。

lightning.use: 听力（天气）· 阅读（灾害/安全）

rainfall.def_en: the amount of rain that falls in a place over a period of time

root.logic: rain(雨)+fall(落下)→降下的雨量→降雨量
root.note: 复合词，由两个自由词素构成。

ex2.en: Annual rainfall in the region has dropped by fifteen per cent over the past four decades.
ex2.zh: 过去四十年里，该地区的年降雨量下降了百分之十五。
ex2.note: rainfall 为不可数名词，常与 annual、average、heavy 搭配；与 rain 的区别在于它强调'量'。

rainfall.use: 写作 Task 1（数据）· 阅读（气候）

shiver.def_en: to shake slightly because you are cold, frightened or ill

root.logic: 联想：sh- 开头的抖动类词（shake、shudder）多表'抖'→发抖
root.note: 词源存疑：以下为助记联想，非严格词源（中古英语 chiveren 来源不明，或为拟声）。

ex2.en: Without proper clothing, children in the camp shivered through the cold desert nights while waiting for supplies.
ex2.zh: 由于缺少合适的衣物，营地里的孩子们在寒冷的沙漠之夜一边等待物资一边发抖。
ex2.note: shiver 多因寒冷或恐惧而抖，常与 with cold 连用；tremble 则更泛指，不限于寒冷。

shiver.use: 听力（天气/户外）· 阅读（叙事类）

sprinkle.def_en: to scatter small drops or pieces over something; to rain lightly

root.logic: sprink(洒)+-le(反复)→反复少量地洒→撒；(雨)零星落下

ex2.en: The gardener sprinkles a thin layer of sand over the seeds to keep the birds away.
ex2.zh: 园丁在种子上撒一层薄沙，以防鸟儿啄食。
ex2.note: 可用 sprinkle A on/over B 或 sprinkle B with A；sprinkle 也指'下小雨'，与 downpour 形成程度对照。

sprinkle.use: 听力 Section 2（园艺）· 阅读（农业）

stormy.def_en: with strong winds and heavy rain; full of strong disagreement

root.logic: storm(暴风雨)+-y(多…的)→有暴风雨的；引申为'激烈的'

ex2.en: Stormy weather in the North Atlantic delayed the research ship by almost a week, forcing scientists to change plans.
ex2.zh: 北大西洋的暴风雨天气使科考船延误了将近一周，科学家们不得不改变计划。
ex2.note: stormy 既形容天气，也形容'激烈的争论'；stormy weather 是航海与气象类高频搭配。

stormy.use: 听力（天气/航海）· 阅读（灾害）

thaw.def_en: to become soft or liquid again after being frozen; a period of warmer weather that melts snow

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，与 freeze 构成反义对

ex2.en: When the ground thaws in spring, meltwater carries fertilisers and soil into nearby rivers and reservoirs.
ex2.zh: 春天土地解冻时，融水会把化肥和土壤带入附近的河流与水库。
ex2.note: thaw 指冰雪'解冻'，与 freeze 相对；the thaw 表'解冻期'，常见于极地与农业话题。

thaw.use: 阅读（气候/农业）· 听力 Section 4

thunder.def_en: the loud noise that you hear after a flash of lightning during a storm

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，不宜拆分

ex2.en: We could hear thunder in the distance long before the first drops of rain fell.
ex2.zh: 早在第一滴雨落下之前，我们就听到远处传来雷声。
ex2.note: thunder 是雷声，lightning 是闪电，二者常成对出现；thunder 亦作动词表'轰隆作响'。

thunder.use: 听力（天气）· 阅读（灾害）

tremble.def_en: to shake slightly and uncontrollably, especially from fear, cold or weakness

root.logic: trem(颤抖)+-ble→发抖
root.note: 经古法语 trembler 进入英语。

ex2.en: Her hands trembled as she read the letter offering her a place at the university.
ex2.zh: 读那封给她大学录取名额的信时，她的双手在颤抖。
ex2.note: tremble 比 shiver 更强调不受控制的颤动，常与 with fear/anger 连用；trembling 可作形容词。

tremble.use: 阅读（叙事/心理）· 听力 Section 3

celsius.def_en: a scale of temperature on which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees

root.base: Celsius(瑞典天文学家 Anders Celsius 的姓氏)
root.logic: 专有名词：由人名 Celsius 转指其设计的温标→摄氏的
root.note: 专有名词，不作词根拆解。

ex2.en: Scientists warn that global temperatures may rise by one point five degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels.
ex2.zh: 科学家警告，全球气温可能比工业化前水平升高 1.5 摄氏度。
ex2.note: Celsius 首字母大写，常与 degree(s) 连用；美式口语中也用 centigrade，但科学写作统一用 Celsius。

celsius.use: 听力 Section 4 · 写作（环境/数据描述）

forecast.def_en: a statement about what is likely to happen, especially about the weather; to predict

root.logic: fore(预先)+cast(抛出)→预先抛出判断→预报

ex2.en: Analysts forecast that demand for electric vehicles will double within the next decade as prices fall.
ex2.zh: 分析人士预测，随着价格下降，电动汽车的需求将在未来十年内翻一番。
ex2.note: forecast 的过去式和过去分词通常仍为 forecast；weather forecast 与 economic forecast 均高频。

forecast.use: 写作 Task 1（趋势）· 听力（天气）

hillside.def_en: the sloping side of a hill, especially one used for farming or walking

root.logic: hill(小山)+side(侧面)→山的侧面→山坡
root.note: 复合词，两个自由词素构成。

ex2.en: Trees were planted across the hillside to stop soil from washing into the reservoir during heavy summer storms.
ex2.zh: 整个山坡都种上了树，以防止夏季暴雨时土壤被冲进水库。
ex2.note: 方位介词用 on the hillside；与 hilltop、valley floor 构成地形方位词系列。

hillside.use: 听力（地图题）· 阅读（地理）

mount.def_en: to increase gradually; to climb onto or up something; (in names) a mountain

root.logic: mount 由拉丁语 mons(山)经古法语 monter(登上)而来→登上；山
root.note: 同源词 mountain、amount、paramount。

ex2.en: Pressure on water supplies is mounting as the city's population continues to expand and rainfall becomes less reliable.
ex2.zh: 随着城市人口持续增长、降雨变得越来越不稳定，供水压力不断上升。
ex2.note: mount 作'增加'时多为不及物动词，常用进行时；Mount Everest 中 mount 用于山名。

mount.use: 写作（趋势描述）· 阅读（地理）

mountain.def_en: a very high hill, often with steep sides and a rocky top

root.logic: mount(山)+-ain→山岳
root.note: 经古法语 montaigne 进入英语。

ex2.en: The mountain range forms a natural barrier between the wet coast and the dry interior.
ex2.zh: 这条山脉在湿润的沿海与干燥的内陆之间形成一道天然屏障。
ex2.note: mountain range 指山脉；mountain 多指高大山峰，hill 指小山，二者在地理描述中需区分。

mountain.use: 阅读（地理）· 听力（旅游）

overlook.def_en: to have a view of something from above; to fail to notice or consider something

root.logic: over(从上)+look(看)→从高处往下看→俯瞰；视线越过而未见→忽略

ex2.en: The hotel overlooks the bay, and every room has a balcony facing the water and the fishing harbour.
ex2.zh: 这家酒店俯瞰海湾，每个房间都有一个面向水面和渔港的阳台。
ex2.note: overlook 有'俯瞰'与'忽视'两个几乎相反的含义，靠宾语和语境判断；酒店介绍中常见'俯瞰'义。

overlook.use: 听力 Section 1（住宿）· 阅读（评论）

peak.def_en: the pointed top of a mountain; the highest point or level of something

root.logic: 联想：peak 与 pike(尖头) 形近→尖顶→山峰；引申为'顶点'
root.note: 词源存疑：以下为助记联想，非严格词源（可能源自 pike 的'尖'义）。

ex2.en: Tourist numbers peak in August, putting enormous pressure on the island's water supply and waste systems.
ex2.zh: 游客数量在八月达到高峰，给岛上的供水和垃圾处理系统带来巨大压力。
ex2.note: peak 可作名词'顶峰'、动词'达到高峰'；peak season 表'旺季'，是旅游类话题高频词。

peak.use: 写作 Task 1（趋势）· 听力（旅游）

rainbow.def_en: a curved band of colours that appears in the sky when sunlight passes through rain

root.logic: rain(雨)+bow(弓)→雨后的弓形彩带→彩虹
root.note: 复合词，bow 取'弓形'义。

ex2.en: A rainbow appeared over the valley as soon as the storm passed and the sun came out.
ex2.zh: 暴风雨一过、太阳出来，山谷上空就出现了一道彩虹。
ex2.note: rainbow 是 rain+bow 复合词；chase rainbows 为习语，指追求不切实际的目标。

rainbow.use: 听力（天气）· 阅读（自然描写）

range.def_en: a line of mountains or hills; the limits between which something varies

root.base: rang(行列，法兰克语 hring 环、行)
root.logic: rang(排成行)→连绵的一排→山脉；排开的幅度→范围
root.note: 经古法语 range 进入英语。

ex2.en: The course covers a wide range of topics, from plate movement and coastal erosion to urban flooding.
ex2.zh: 这门课程涵盖广泛的主题，从板块运动和海岸侵蚀到城市内涝。
ex2.note: a wide range of + 复数名词表'广泛的一系列'，是写作高分结构；mountain range 指山脉。

range.use: 写作（范围/多样性）· 阅读（地理）

ridge.def_en: a long narrow raised part along the top of a hill or mountain

root.logic: 整体记忆：由'脊背'引申为山脊、隆起物

ex2.en: The ridge separates two river systems and forms the natural border between the two provinces.
ex2.zh: 这道山脊分隔了两大水系，并构成两省之间的天然边界。
ex2.note: ridge 指'山脊'，也可指屋顶或沙地上的隆起；ridge line 为地形学术语。

ridge.use: 阅读（地理）· 听力（地图题）

shower.def_en: a short period of rain; a wash under falling water; to fall in small drops

root.logic: 整体记忆：由'一阵骤雨'引申为'一阵（淋浴、礼物等）'

ex2.en: Scattered showers are expected in the afternoon, so bring a light jacket and allow extra time for travel.
ex2.zh: 预计下午有零星阵雨，所以请带件薄外套，并为出行多留些时间。
ex2.note: shower 表'阵雨'时可数，天气预报常用复数 showers；scattered showers 是固定说法。

shower.use: 听力 Section 1/2（天气）· 阅读（气候）

slope.def_en: a surface that is higher at one end than the other; to be at an angle rather than level

root.base: slop(滑，古英语 slūpan 滑动)
root.logic: slop(滑动)+-e→可以滑下的面→斜坡；倾斜
root.note: 由中古英语 aslope(倾斜地) 逆构而来。

ex2.en: The field slopes gently towards the river, which makes irrigation relatively easy and reduces the cost of pumping.
ex2.zh: 这块田缓缓向河边倾斜，这使得灌溉相对容易，并降低了抽水成本。
ex2.note: slope 可作名词'斜坡'、动词'倾斜'；gentle/steep slope 表坡度大小，是地形描述核心词。

slope.use: 听力（地图/地形）· 阅读（地理）

southern.def_en: in or from the south of a place, or typical of that region

root.logic: south(南)+-ern(…方向的)→南部的
root.note: 同类构词：eastern、western、northern。

ex2.en: Southern Europe has suffered from longer and more intense heatwaves in recent summers, damaging crops and straining hospitals.
ex2.zh: 近几个夏天，南欧遭受了持续时间更长、强度更高的热浪，损毁庄稼并使医院不堪重负。
ex2.note: southern 作定语时通常小写，但 South Africa 等专名除外；Southern Hemisphere 表'南半球'。

southern.use: 写作（地理/气候）· 听力（地图题）

temperature.def_en: a measure of how hot or cold something or someone is

root.logic: temper(调和)+-ature→调和到的程度→温度

ex2.en: Average summer temperatures in the city have risen by two degrees since the 1980s, according to official records.
ex2.zh: 根据官方记录，自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，该市夏季平均气温上升了两度。
ex2.note: temperature 与介词 at 连用（at a temperature of）；take sb's temperature 表'量体温'。

temperature.use: 写作 Task 1（数据）· 听力 Section 4

valley.def_en: a low area of land between hills, often with a river flowing through it

root.logic: vall(谷)+-ey→山谷
root.note: 经古法语 valee 进入英语。

ex2.en: The valley is fertile because floods have deposited rich silt over thousands of years, attracting farmers since ancient times.
ex2.zh: 这个山谷土地肥沃，因为千百年来洪水沉积了丰富的淤泥，自古就吸引着农民。
ex2.note: valley 常与 fertile、narrow、river 搭配；the Valley 在口语中可指硅谷，需靠语境判断。

valley.use: 阅读（地理）· 听力（地图题）

abnormal.def_en: different from what is usual or expected, especially in a worrying way

root.base: norm(规则，拉丁语 norma 木尺)
root.logic: ab(偏离)+norm(规则)+-al→偏离常规的→反常的

ex2.en: Abnormal levels of nitrogen in the river were traced to fertiliser running off nearby farms.
ex2.zh: 河中异常的氮含量被追查到源于附近农场流失的化肥。
ex2.note: abnormal 含'异常且不妙'的意味，比 unusual 更负面；abnormal behaviour 为心理与医学常用语。

abnormal.use: 阅读（科学/医学）· 写作（环境）

clay.def_en: heavy sticky earth that becomes hard when baked, used for making pots and bricks

root.logic: 整体记忆：本族词，不宜拆分

ex2.en: The soil here contains too much clay, so water drains slowly and roots often rot.
ex2.zh: 这里的土壤含黏土过多，因此排水缓慢，根系常常腐烂。
ex2.note: clay soil 指黏质土，是农业与地质类阅读的高频词；clay pot 指陶罐。

clay.use: 阅读（农业/地质）· 听力 Section 4

dirt.def_en: unclean matter such as dust or mud; (especially American) soil

root.logic: 整体记忆：由'污物'扩展为'泥土'（美式常用）
root.note: 借自古诺尔斯语，与古英语同义形式并存。

ex2.en: Children who play in the dirt may develop stronger immune systems, some researchers argue, though the evidence remains limited.
ex2.zh: 一些研究者认为，在泥土里玩耍的孩子可能形成更强的免疫系统，尽管证据仍然有限。
ex2.note: 美式英语中 dirt 常指'泥土'，英式多用 soil；dirt cheap 表'极其便宜'。

dirt.use: 阅读（健康/社会）· 听力 Section 3

eastern.def_en: in or from the east of a place, or typical of that region

root.logic: east(东)+-ern(…方向的)→东部的

ex2.en: Eastern coastal cities have grown much faster than those in the interior, widening the gap between regions.
ex2.zh: 东部沿海城市的发展速度远快于内陆城市，拉大了地区之间的差距。
ex2.note: eastern 作普通定语时小写；Eastern Europe 等固定名称首字母大写，属专有表达。

eastern.use: 写作（城市/经济）· 听力（地图题）

inappropriate.def_en: not suitable or acceptable for a particular situation or social context

root.base: appropri(合适的，拉丁语 proprius 自己的)
root.logic: in(不)+appropriate(合适的)→不合适的

ex2.en: Using informal language in an academic essay is considered inappropriate by most examiners and may lower your score.
ex2.zh: 多数学术写作考官认为在论文中使用口语化表达不合适，这可能降低你的分数。
ex2.note: inappropriate 后常接 for/to；it is inappropriate to do sth 是正式句型，写作中用于评价行为是否得体。

inappropriate.use: 写作（评价类）· 阅读（教育/社会）

inevitable.def_en: certain to happen and impossible to avoid, however much you may want to

root.logic: in(不)+evit(避开)+-able→不可避开的→不可避免的

ex2.en: Some job losses are inevitable as automation spreads through the manufacturing sector, but retraining could soften the impact.
ex2.zh: 随着自动化在制造业蔓延，一些失业是不可避免的，但再培训可以缓和其影响。
ex2.note: inevitable 常作表语，也可用 it is inevitable that… 句型；写作中用于表达必然趋势。

inevitable.use: 写作（科技/社会）· 阅读（评论）

irregularly.def_en: in a way that is not even, not regular, or not at fixed times

root.base: regular(规则的，来自拉丁语 regula 尺子)
root.logic: ir(不)+regular(规则的)+-ly→不按规则地→不规则地
root.note: ir- 是 in- 在 r 前的同化形式。

ex2.en: Rain falls irregularly in this region, so farmers cannot depend on a single rainy season.
ex2.zh: 该地区降雨不规律，因此农民无法依赖单一的雨季。
ex2.note: irregularly 常修饰 rainfall、spaced、occur 等，表'间隔不均、时间不定'，属气候与农业类描述词。

irregularly.use: 写作 Task 1（趋势）· 阅读（气候）

irreversible.def_en: impossible to change back to a previous state or condition

root.logic: ir(不)+revers(反转)+-ible→不可反转的→不可逆转的

ex2.en: Once the permafrost melts, the release of methane may become irreversible within decades, scientists warn.
ex2.zh: 科学家警告，一旦永久冻土融化，甲烷的释放可能在几十年内变得不可逆转。
ex2.note: irreversible 强调'不可逆'，是环境类写作的高分词；irreversible damage 为高频搭配。

irreversible.use: 写作（环境）· 阅读（科学）

muddy.def_en: covered with mud, or full of mud, and therefore not clear

root.logic: mud(泥)+-y(多…的)→泥泞的
root.note: 加 -y 时双写 d，保持短元音读音。

ex2.en: Heavy trucks left the track muddy, and the following runners struggled to keep their footing.
ex2.zh: 重型卡车把跑道弄得泥泞不堪，后面的跑者很难站稳。
ex2.note: muddy 由 mud+-y 构成并双写 d；muddy the waters 为习语，指'把事情搅乱'。

muddy.use: 听力（户外/运动）· 阅读（地理）

northeast.def_en: the direction between north and east; in or from that direction

root.logic: north(北)+east(东)→北与东之间→东北
root.note: 复合方位词，重音落在后一成分。

ex2.en: The northeast of the country is drier and colder than the coastal plains in the south.
ex2.zh: 该国东北部比南方的沿海平原更干燥、更寒冷。
ex2.note: the northeast of + 地名 表'…的东北部'；作定语时也可用 northeastern，如 northeastern China。

northeast.use: 听力（地图题）· 写作（区域描述）

northwest.def_en: the direction between north and west; in or from that direction

root.logic: north(北)+west(西)→北与西之间→西北
root.note: 复合方位词，重音落在后一成分。

ex2.en: Prevailing northwest winds bring cool, moist air to the western slopes of the range throughout the winter.
ex2.zh: 整个冬季，盛行的西北风把凉爽湿润的空气带到山脉西坡。
ex2.note: northwest wind 指来自西北方向的风；中英文风向表述一致，均由'来向'命名。

northwest.use: 听力（地图题）· 阅读（气候）

oriental.def_en: relating to the countries of East Asia, especially China and Japan

root.base: orient(升起的方向，拉丁语 oriens 日出的)
root.logic: orient(太阳升起处)+-al→东方的
root.note: orient 原义'日出之处'，故指东方。

ex2.en: The museum's oriental collection includes ceramics traded along the ancient Silk Road and rare Japanese prints.
ex2.zh: 该博物馆的东方藏品包括沿古代丝绸之路交易的陶瓷和稀有的日本版画。
ex2.note: 指艺术品或风格时仍可用，但用来指人（an Oriental）在现代英语中被视为冒犯，宜改用 Asian。

oriental.use: 阅读（文化/历史）· 写作（文化类）

sediment.def_en: solid material such as sand or mud that settles at the bottom of water

root.logic: sed(坐下)+-iment→沉下来的东西→沉积物

ex2.en: Sediment carried by the river has built up a fertile delta over the past few centuries.
ex2.zh: 河流携带的沉积物在过去几百年间堆积成了一片肥沃的三角洲。
ex2.note: sediment 指'沉积物'，可作不可数名词；sedimentary rock 表'沉积岩'，是地质类阅读核心术语。

sediment.use: 阅读（地质）· 听力 Section 4

silt.def_en: fine sand or mud carried by water and left behind when the water slows down

root.logic: 联想：silt 与 sediment 同场景记忆→水中沉积的细泥→淤泥
root.note: 词源存疑：以下为助记联想，非严格词源（或借自斯堪的纳维亚语，指盐沼）。

ex2.en: Dams trap silt that would otherwise rebuild the beaches downstream, so many coastlines are now retreating.
ex2.zh: 水坝拦住了原本会重建下游海滩的淤泥，因此许多海岸线如今正在后退。
ex2.note: silt 指河流携带的细泥沙；silt up 表'淤塞'，常与港口、水库连用，是环境类阅读常见表达。

silt.use: 阅读（河流/地质）· 写作（环境）

southeast.def_en: the direction between south and east; in or from that direction

root.logic: south(南)+east(东)→南与东之间→东南
root.note: 复合方位词，重音落在后一成分。

ex2.en: The southeast coast is most exposed to tropical storms between July and October, when insurance costs rise sharply.
ex2.zh: 东南沿海在七月至十月间最易受热带风暴影响，此时保险费会大幅上涨。
ex2.note: 方位词可作名词或定语；the southeast of + 地名 表'…的东南部'，常用于地理描述与地图题。

southeast.use: 听力（地图题）· 阅读（气候）

southwest.def_en: the direction between south and west; in or from that direction

root.logic: south(南)+west(西)→南与西之间→西南
root.note: 复合方位词，重音落在后一成分。

ex2.en: Dry southwest winds sweep across the plain, raising dust and reducing air quality in nearby towns.
ex2.zh: 干燥的西南风扫过平原，扬起尘土并降低附近城镇的空气质量。
ex2.note: southwest 表方向，southwestward 表'向西南的'；二者在描述气流移动时需区分。

southwest.use: 听力（地图题）· 阅读（气候）

adjacent.def_en: next to or very near something else, often sharing a border with it

root.logic: ad(靠近)+jac(躺)+-ent→躺在旁边的→邻近的

ex2.en: The new campus is adjacent to the science park, so students can walk between them.
ex2.zh: 新校区紧邻科技园，学生们可以步行往返。
ex2.note: adjacent to 是固定搭配，比 next to 正式；写作中描述位置关系时常用，也可说 adjacent buildings。

adjacent.use: 听力（地图题）· 写作（城市规划）

border.def_en: the official line that separates two countries or regions; to be next to something

root.logic: bord(边缘)+-er→边界；镶边
root.note: 源自日耳曼语 bord（船板、边缘）。

ex2.en: Millions of people cross the border each year in search of work and better wages.
ex2.zh: 每年有数百万人越过边境去寻找工作和更高的工资。
ex2.note: border 指国界或边界，boundary 更泛指界线；border on 表'与…接壤'或'近乎'。

border.use: 阅读（社会/地理）· 写作（移民话题）

contaminate.def_en: to make something dirty or poisonous by adding a harmful substance

root.base: tamin(接触，拉丁语 tangere 的变体)
root.logic: con(一起)+tamin(接触)+-ate→接触而沾污→污染
root.note: 拉丁语 contaminare 本义'使接触而弄脏'。

ex2.en: Industrial waste has contaminated the groundwater that local villages rely on for drinking and for irrigating crops.
ex2.zh: 工业废料污染了当地村庄赖以饮水和灌溉作物的地下水。
ex2.note: contaminate 强调'因接触有害物而受污染'，比 pollute 更具体；contaminated water 为高频搭配。

contaminate.use: 写作（环境）· 阅读（公共卫生）

desolate.def_en: empty of people and looking sad or frightening; feeling very lonely

root.logic: de(完全)+sol(单独)+-ate→完全空无一人→荒凉的

ex2.en: The village was left desolate after the mine closed and the young people moved away.
ex2.zh: 矿井关闭、年轻人迁走之后，这个村庄变得荒凉冷清。
ex2.note: desolate 兼指'无人烟'与'凄凉'，比 empty 更具情感色彩，常修饰 village、landscape。

desolate.use: 阅读（社会/地理）· 写作（描写）

distant.def_en: far away in space or time; not friendly or close

root.logic: dis(分开)+st(站)+-ant→站得远远的→遥远的

ex2.en: Satellite images now let scientists monitor distant forests that nobody can reach on foot or by road.
ex2.zh: 如今卫星图像让科学家能够监测那些无人能徒步或乘车抵达的远方森林。
ex2.note: distant 可指空间、时间或关系疏远；in the distant future 为高频短语，写作中用于预测。

distant.use: 阅读（科技/环境）· 写作（趋势预测）

geology.def_en: the scientific study of the earth's rocks, soil and structure

root.logic: geo(地球)+log(学问)+-y→研究地球的学科→地质学

ex2.en: The geology of the area explains why landslides are so common after heavy rain in late summer.
ex2.zh: 该地区的地质构造解释了为什么夏末暴雨后山体滑坡如此常见。
ex2.note: geology 既指'地质学'也指某地的'地质构造'；geologist 指地质学家，是 Section 4 讲座高频词。

geology.use: 阅读（科学类）· 听力 Section 4

outskirts.def_en: the areas of a town or city that are furthest from its centre

root.logic: out(在外)+skirt(边缘)→城墙外的边缘地带→市郊
root.note: skirt 的'边缘'义保留在该词与 outskirt 中。

ex2.en: The new factory was built on the outskirts, where land is cheaper and roads are wider.
ex2.zh: 新工厂建在市郊，那里地价更便宜、道路更宽阔。
ex2.note: on the outskirts of + 城市 是固定搭配，介词用 on；outskirts 恒为复数，是城市规划类高频词。

outskirts.use: 写作（城市）· 听力（地图题）

pollutant.def_en: a substance that makes air, water or soil dirty and harmful

root.base: pollut(污染，拉丁语 polluere 弄脏)
root.logic: pollut(污染)+-ant→造成污染的物质→污染物

ex2.en: Coal-fired power stations remain the largest source of sulphur pollutants in the region, despite recent upgrades.
ex2.zh: 尽管近年进行了升级改造，燃煤电厂仍是该地区硫污染物的最大来源。
ex2.note: pollutant 为可数名词，-ant 表'起…作用的东西'；常与 emit、release、reduce 搭配。

pollutant.use: 写作（环境）· 阅读（公共卫生）

pollution.def_en: damage caused to air, water or soil by harmful substances

root.base: pollut(污染，拉丁语 polluere 弄脏)
root.logic: pollut(弄脏)+-ion→被弄脏的状态→污染

ex2.en: Air pollution from traffic is now the biggest environmental risk to public health in cities.
ex2.zh: 交通造成的空气污染现在是城市公共健康面临的最大环境风险。
ex2.note: pollution 为不可数名词，不说 a pollution；air/water/noise pollution 为常见搭配，是环境类写作核心词。

pollution.use: 写作（环境）· 阅读（公共卫生）

remote.def_en: far away from towns and cities; distant in time or in relationship

root.logic: re(离开)+mot(移动)→被移得很远→遥远的；偏僻的

ex2.en: Doctors use drones to deliver medicines to remote villages cut off by floods during the monsoon season.
ex2.zh: 医生用无人机向季风季节被洪水阻隔的偏远村庄运送药品。
ex2.note: remote 指'偏远'，常修饰 area、village、region；remote control 则表'遥控'，词义需靠搭配判断。

remote.use: 写作（城乡差距）· 阅读（科技/医疗）

rural.def_en: relating to the countryside rather than to towns or cities

root.logic: rur(乡村)+-al→乡村的

ex2.en: Young people continue to leave rural areas in search of better-paid jobs in the cities.
ex2.zh: 年轻人仍在离开农村地区，到城市寻找报酬更高的工作。
ex2.note: rural 与 urban 相对，是城市规划与人口迁移话题的核心对比词，常与 area、population、decline 搭配。

rural.use: 写作（城市化）· 阅读（社会类）

suburb.def_en: an area where people live outside the centre of a city

root.logic: sub(靠近)+urb(城市)→紧挨城市的地区→郊区

ex2.en: Housing in the suburbs is cheaper, but commuters spend hours travelling to work and lose family time.
ex2.zh: 郊区的住房更便宜，但通勤者要花几个小时上下班，牺牲了陪伴家人的时间。
ex2.note: suburb 常以复数出现（the suburbs）；与 outskirts 相比，suburb 更强调居住功能与社区属性。

suburb.use: 写作（城市/住房）· 听力（租房场景）

toxic.def_en: containing poison, or extremely harmful to health and to the environment

root.logic: tox(箭)+-ic→涂在箭上的毒→有毒的
root.note: 希腊语 toxikon pharmakon 指'用于箭的毒药'。

ex2.en: The factory was fined for dumping toxic chemicals into the river for over a decade.
ex2.zh: 该工厂因十多年来向河中倾倒有毒化学品而被罚款。
ex2.note: toxic 比 poisonous 更常用于工业与环境语境；toxic waste 指'有毒废料'，toxic 也可喻'有害的（关系、文化）'。

toxic.use: 写作（环境/工业）· 阅读（公共卫生）

crack.def_en: a narrow line where something has broken but not separated; to break with a sharp sound

root.base: crack(古英语 cracian，发出爆裂声)
root.logic: 整体记忆：拟声词，先有'爆裂声'义，再引申为'裂缝'

ex2.en: Cracks in the dam wall were spotted by a routine inspection last spring, prompting urgent repairs.
ex2.zh: 去年春天的一次例行检查发现了坝体上的裂缝，随即启动了紧急维修。
ex2.note: crack 可作名词'裂缝'、动词'裂开'；crack down on 表'严厉打击'，属政策类阅读常见短语。

crack.use: 阅读（工程/灾害）· 听力 Section 4

debris.def_en: pieces of broken material left after something has been destroyed

root.logic: dé(向下)+briser(打碎)→被打碎的东西→碎片、残骸
root.note: 借自法语 débris，词尾 s 不发音。

ex2.en: Rescue teams searched the debris for survivors after the earthquake struck the town early on Tuesday morning.
ex2.zh: 周二清晨地震袭击该镇后，救援队在废墟中搜寻生还者。
ex2.note: debris 为不可数名词，读 /dəˈbriː/，s 不发音；常与 clear、scatter、search 连用，属灾害类阅读高频词。

debris.use: 阅读（灾害）· 听力 Section 3（新闻讨论）

desert.def_en: a large dry area of land with little rain and few plants; to leave someone without help

root.logic: de(分开)+sert(连接)→断开联系→遗弃；被遗弃之地→沙漠
root.note: 名词与动词读音不同，拼写也易与 dessert（甜点）混淆。

ex2.en: The desert is expanding southwards as overgrazing strips the land of vegetation and rainfall becomes less predictable.
ex2.zh: 由于过度放牧使土地失去植被、降雨变得越来越难以预测，沙漠正向南扩张。
ex2.note: 此处 desert 为名词'沙漠'，读 /ˈdezərt/；动词'遗弃'读 /dɪˈzɜːrt/，写作中描述荒漠化时常用名词形式。

desert.use: 写作（环境/荒漠化）· 阅读（地理）

dramatic.def_en: sudden and very noticeable; also relating to plays and to acting

root.base: dramat(戏剧，希腊语 drama 动作、剧)
root.logic: dramat(戏剧)+-ic→戏剧般的→引人注目的

ex2.en: There has been a dramatic fall in the cost of solar panels over the last ten years.
ex2.zh: 过去十年间，太阳能板的成本大幅下降。
ex2.note: a dramatic increase/fall 是图表作文的高分搭配，表'显著变化'，可替换 big 或 sharp。

dramatic.use: 写作 Task 1（图表）· 阅读（评论）

fringe.def_en: the outer edge of an area; a border of loose threads on cloth

root.logic: fring(流苏)+-e→边缘；非主流
root.note: 经古法语 frenge 进入英语。

ex2.en: Housing on the fringes of the city is spreading into valuable farmland, alarming local planners.
ex2.zh: 城市边缘的住宅正向宝贵的农田蔓延，这让当地规划者感到担忧。
ex2.note: on the fringe(s) of 表'在…边缘'，也可指'非主流群体'；fringe benefit 表'额外福利'。

fringe.use: 阅读（城市/社会）· 写作（城市化）

gap.def_en: an empty space or hole; a difference between two things or groups

root.logic: 整体记忆：由'张开的缺口'引申为差距、空白

ex2.en: The gap between rich and poor widened sharply during the last decade, according to the latest national survey.
ex2.zh: 根据最新的全国调查，过去十年间贫富差距急剧扩大。
ex2.note: the gap between A and B 是社会经济类写作的核心结构；bridge/close the gap 表'缩小差距'。

gap.use: 写作（社会不平等）· 阅读（经济类）

grand.def_en: large and impressive in size or appearance; important and ambitious

root.logic: 整体记忆：grandis 即'大'，引申为'宏大、气派'

ex2.en: The government announced a grand plan to plant two billion trees by 2030, but critics doubt the funding.
ex2.zh: 政府宣布了一项宏伟计划，要在 2030 年前种植二十亿棵树，但批评者质疑资金来源。
ex2.note: grand 含'宏大、有气派'之义，略带褒扬；a grand plan/scheme 常见于政策类文章。

grand.use: 写作（政策/规划）· 阅读（建筑/文化）

interesting.def_en: holding your attention because it is unusual, new or enjoyable

root.base: interest(使感兴趣，拉丁语 inter- 之间 + esse 存在)
root.logic: interest(使感兴趣)+-ing→令人感兴趣的

ex2.en: The lecture was interesting, but it offered few practical solutions to the housing crisis facing the city.
ex2.zh: 这场讲座很有意思，但对这座城市面临的住房危机几乎没有提出实际解决方案。
ex2.note: interesting 语气较弱，学术写作中宜用 compelling、notable 等更精确的评价词。

interesting.use: 听力 Section 3（课堂讨论）· 写作（评价）

magnificent.def_en: extremely beautiful, impressive or grand, especially in appearance or scale

root.logic: magni(大)+fic(做)+-ent→做得宏大→壮丽的

ex2.en: The cathedral is magnificent, with a ceiling that visitors can study for hours without losing interest.
ex2.zh: 这座大教堂极为壮丽，其穹顶足以让参观者细看数小时而不觉厌倦。
ex2.note: magnificent 多用于视觉上的'壮丽'，修饰建筑、景色或成就，语气强于 beautiful。

magnificent.use: 阅读（建筑/旅游）· 听力（景点介绍）

margin.def_en: the empty space at the side of a page; the amount by which one thing is more than another

root.logic: 整体记忆：margo 本义'边'，引申为页边、差额、余地

ex2.en: The team won by a narrow margin, which surprised most commentators who had expected a comfortable victory.
ex2.zh: 这支队伍以微弱优势获胜，这让原本预期会轻松取胜的大多数评论员感到意外。
ex2.note: by a narrow/wide margin 表'以微弱/明显优势'；margin 也可指'利润空间'，是经济类阅读常用词。

margin.use: 写作 Task 1（数据对比）· 阅读（经济）

plate.def_en: one of the large moving pieces of the earth's outer shell; a flat dish

root.logic: plat(平坦)+-e→平板→（地质）板块
root.note: '板块'义由 plate tectonics（板块构造学说）而来。

ex2.en: Earthquakes occur where two tectonic plates slide past each other, releasing energy stored in the crust.
ex2.zh: 地震发生在两个构造板块相互错动的地方，释放出地壳中积聚的能量。
ex2.note: plate 在地质语境中特指'板块'，完整术语为 tectonic plate；plate boundary 表'板块边界'。

plate.use: 阅读（地质）· 听力 Section 4

splendid.def_en: very impressive and beautiful, or excellent in a way that people admire

root.logic: splend(发光)+-id→光彩夺目的→壮丽的；极好的

ex2.en: The garden offers a splendid view of the valley in autumn, when the leaves turn gold and red.
ex2.zh: 这座花园在秋天可以望见山谷的壮丽景色，那时树叶变成金黄与红色。
ex2.note: splendid 兼有'壮丽'与'极好'两义，语气比 good 强但略显旧式，常见于景点介绍。

splendid.use: 听力（景点介绍）· 阅读（旅游）

super.def_en: extremely good, or larger and more powerful than usual (informal use)

root.logic: super(在上)→高于一般→超级的
root.note: 多作构词成分，如 supermarket、superpower。

ex2.en: The new super hospital will serve patients from three neighbouring counties and reduce waiting times.
ex2.zh: 这座新建的超级医院将为三个邻县的病人服务，并缩短等候时间。
ex2.note: super 作前置成分表'超级'，多用于口语或构词；正式写作宜用 extremely 或 exceptionally。

super.use: 听力 Section 1（口语）· 阅读（科技）

wilderness.def_en: a large natural area of land that has never been built on or farmed

root.base: wilder(由 wild 派生；古英语 wilddēor 野兽)
root.logic: wild(野)+-ness→野兽出没、无人耕作之地→荒野
root.note: 古英语 wilddēoren 意为'野兽之地'，后义为'荒野'。

ex2.en: Only a small share of the world's wilderness remains untouched by human activity, and it is shrinking fast.
ex2.zh: 世界上只有一小部分荒野仍未受人类活动影响，而这部分正在迅速缩小。
ex2.note: wilderness 指未开发的荒野，常与 protect、preserve 连用；in the wilderness 也可喻'被冷落、失势'。

wilderness.use: 写作（环境保护）· 阅读（生态）

barren.def_en: unable to produce plants or crops; not able to have children

root.logic: 联想：bar(阻挡)+ren→什么都长不出来→贫瘠的
root.note: 词源存疑：以下为助记联想，非严格词源（古法语词源不明）。

ex2.en: Years of overgrazing have turned once fertile grassland into barren soil that cannot hold water.
ex2.zh: 多年的过度放牧把曾经肥沃的草原变成了无法蓄水的贫瘠土壤。
ex2.note: barren 强调'贫瘠不毛'，常修饰 land、soil、landscape，与 fertile 相对，是荒漠化话题的高频词。

barren.use: 写作（环境/荒漠化）· 阅读（农业）
